column1: # ACTION SW / T229-1 (p229) - repository names containing a DOT, truncated by p228's harvester.
# SLUG_RE allows '.' inside the name AND terminates on '.', and is NON-GREEDY, so the
# lookahead wins at the first dot: processing/p5.js -> processing/p5.
# 0 of 12 truncations resolve to a DIFFERENT real repository, so the defect costs SILENCE,
# never a wrong grant attributed to the wrong subject. Measured, not assumed.
